caveat_refs: Section 5.1, p. 7: "We evaluate twelve VLMs spanning general-purpose and medical-domain model families, multiple parameter scales, and different inference regimes."
Appendix C.1, p. 19: "Because these annotations are defined on different image subsets, no single task is eligible for all 2,512 images."
Appendix D.3.3, p. 25: "Because diagnosis and detection use different ISIC annotation subsets, the comparison concerns dataset-level performance"

notes: The claim combines the 12-VLM main breast-imaging evaluation (Tables 3, 4, 5, and 11-15, which include BreastGPT-8B and aggregate Overall scores in Table 3) with the cross-domain ISIC 2018 portability case study (Table 10, which includes 11 VLMs and no aggregate score column). Furthermore, the claim that evaluation reveals 'task- and setting-specific variation obscured by aggregate scores' is qualitative/distributional and cannot be fully encoded with the allowed primitives (hence partial: true). Exact metric ties in Table 10 include: Neg. net. Accuracy (45.3 for InternVL3-8B and MedGemma-4B) and Pigment net. Accuracy (72.4 for InternVL3-8B, Qwen2.5-VL-32B, and Lingshu-32B; 59.5 for Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B-I).
